notes.anchor_state_rows: one row per fixed 5-min anchor of the full grid
notes.event_state_rows: one row per interictal event in a carry segment
notes.seed_policy: 3 seeds for the core producers; P_memoryless is a pre-registered seed-1 sensitivity arm and is complete at one seed
notes.state_layout: columns [z_fast | z_slow]; d_fast/d_slow in each result.json

selection_objective: TRAIN chronological inner-validation: the training objective itself (local endpoints excluding group_size, plus each horizon's future-block terms at their frozen weights).  No seizure label and no development-test number enters checkpoint selection.
